title: Figure 9. Thick (left) and Thin (right) Shell Warp Bubble 3D surface plots
description: Two side-by-side 3D surface plots on -10 to 10 axes showing a warp bubble profile with a raised wall and a depressed region, contrasting a thick shell (left) with a thin shell (right). Caption: "Figure 9. Two Images Illustrating the Contrast Between a Thick (left) and Thin (right) Shell Warp Bubble", noting that a thin shell model could dramatically reduce energy requirements. Text includes equation (7.5) for required energy density.
